description: This Java source file defines the GetFilterBsonVisitor class, which creates MongoDB BSON filter objects for field-based search criteria in the context of the Eclipse Ditto project. The class implements methods to generate filters based on expressions, handling authorization and different field types.

classes.name: GetFilterBsonVisitor
classes.description: A visitor class that creates BSON filters for field-based queries, implementing the FilterFieldExpressionVisitor interface.

methods.name: apply
methods.description: Static method to create a BSON filter from a given expression and predicate function, considering authorization.

methods.name: sudoApply
methods.description: Static method to create a BSON filter from a given expression and predicate function without considering authorization.

methods.name: visitAttribute
methods.description: Creates a BSON filter for an attribute key.

methods.name: visitFeatureIdProperty
methods.description: Creates a BSON filter for a feature ID and property.

methods.name: visitPointer
methods.description: Creates a BSON filter based on a pointer string.

methods.name: visitRootLevelField
methods.description: Creates a BSON filter directly from a root-level field name using the predicate function.

methods.name: matchKeyValue
methods.description: Helper method to create a BSON filter matching a key-value pair with authorization considerations.
